name: Waldkappel (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Waldkappel (a blue chapel between green trees on white).
history: Municipal flag of Waldkappel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Waldkappel arms — chapel between trees on white
